visual_action: A fast-paced montage shows clips of Vice President Kamala Harris in various settings. Scenes include her laughing under falling confetti, waving under an umbrella at an outdoor rally, being sworn into office, speaking at a podium, interacting with President Joe Biden, clapping, and talking on the phone while outdoors in athletic wear.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Kamala Harris is featured in every clip of the montage and is named in the on-screen text.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden appears alongside Kamala Harris in several clips and is named in the on-screen text as the person who chose her as his running mate.

cast.name: Roy Blunt
cast.evidence: Roy Blunt is visible in the background over Kamala Harris's shoulder during the inauguration scene.

on_screen_text.text: Two years ago today, President Biden named Kamala Harris as his ✨running mate✨

spoken_summary: A female voiceover, taken from a popular audio clip, states, "She's an icon. She's a legend. And she is the moment. Now come on now."
audio_music: An upbeat, rhythmic pop track plays throughout. The audio is dominated by a female voiceover sample that creates a celebratory and laudatory 'hype' effect.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-cut montage, with clips changing quickly in time with the music.
cultural_references: The audio clip "She's an icon, she's a legend, and she is the moment" is a well-known quote from TV host Wendy Williams, which has become a popular internet meme and TikTok sound.
central_claim: The post celebrates the two-year anniversary of Kamala Harris being chosen as Joe Biden's running mate, framing her as an iconic and legendary figure.
intended_effect: To generate pride and admiration for Vice President Kamala Harris and commemorate a key moment in her political career.
